# Neo4j

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A native graph database management system that stores and queries data as nodes, relationships, and properties.

## Scope note

The specific technology implementing this system's KnowledgeGraph - day nodes, cluster nodes, and their temporal/topical relationships.
